concerns.text: Task T013e (Construct/Validate Environmental Matrix) is marked incomplete `[ ]` but is a strict producer for T015 (MICE Imputation) and T016 (VIF). T015 explicitly depends on 'imputed data' which requires the matrix to exist first. The current order implies T015 can run before T013e is finished, violating the producer-consumer dependency. T013e must be marked complete or moved before T015.

Task T014 (Memory Safety & Streaming) is marked incomplete `[ ]` but is listed as a dependency for T015 and T016 in the 'Within Each User Story' section. T014 describes calculating RAM estimates and triggering subsampling *before* analysis. If T014 is not executed, T015 (MICE) and T016 (VIF) may run on data that exceeds the 7GB RAM constraint, violating FR-009. T014 must precede T015/T016 and be marked complete.

Task T013a1 (Verify dataset count) is marked incomplete `[ ]` but is logically required before T013a/T013b (Download) can proceed safely in Research Mode. The spec requires aborting if <3 datasets are found. If T013a1 is not run first, T013a/b might attempt to download invalid or insufficient data, or T040 (Abort) might trigger after partial work. T013a1 must precede T013a/T013b.

Task T013c2 (Denoising) is marked `[P]` (parallel-safe) but explicitly lists 'Depends on T013c1' (Primer Trimming). While the dependency is noted, the `[P]` tag is misleading if it implies the task can run in parallel with T013c1. The tag should be removed or clarified to indicate it is only parallel-safe *after* T013c1 completes, to avoid confusion in the execution engine.
